title: azdw Work Item Spec File
description: JSON/JSONC file format for creating or updating Azure DevOps work items via 'azdw workitem create --from-file' or 'azdw workitem update --from-file'. Compatible with azdo-wi-creator spec files.

MultiItemSpecFile.description: Spec file with a workItems array containing one or more work item definitions.

workItems.description: Array of work item definitions to create or update.

SingleItemDefinition.description: Shorthand: a single work item definition without the workItems wrapper.

WorkItemDefinition.description: A single work item definition. For creation, at least 'fields' with a Title is required. For update, an 'id' is required.

fields.description: Key-value pairs of field names (short or qualified) to values. Short names (e.g., 'Title') are auto-resolved to qualified names (e.g., 'System.Title'). Rich text fields support markdown content that is auto-converted to HTML.

workItemType.description: Work item type (e.g., 'Bug', 'Task', 'User Story', 'Feature'). Overrides CLI --type and any WorkItemType inside fields. If omitted, falls back to fields.WorkItemType or CLI --type.

project.description: Target Azure DevOps project. Overrides CLI --project or connection default. If both 'project' and 'projects' are present, they are merged (deduplicated).

projects.description: Multiple target projects. One work item is created per project. Merged with 'project' if both present.

areaPaths.description: Target area paths. One work item is created per area path. If empty or omitted, the project root area path is used.

tags.description: Tags to attach to the work item. Can be a comma/semicolon-separated string or an array of strings. The 'azdw' tracking tag is always added automatically.

id.description: Work item ID (for update operations only). Required when using 'workitem update --from-file' with a multi-item file.

sourceRef.description: Symbolic identifier for this item within the batch. Can be referenced by other items via 'relations[].targetRef' or 'parent.targetRef' for intra-batch linking (resolved after Pass 1).

parent.description: Parent relationship. Use 'targetId' for an existing work item ID, or 'targetRef' to reference another item in the same batch by its sourceRef.

targetId.description: Absolute Azure DevOps work item ID of the parent.

targetRef.description: sourceRef of another item in this batch to use as parent.

relations.description: Relationships to establish for this work item. Resolved after all items in the batch have been created (Pass 2).

type.description: Relationship type. Supported: parent, child, related, predecessor, successor, duplicate, duplicateof, hyperlink. Use 'hyperlink' together with 'targetUrl' to link to an arbitrary URL (e.g., an external GitHub issue).

targetId.description: Absolute Azure DevOps work item ID of the relationship target. Mutually exclusive with targetRef and targetUrl.

targetRef.description: sourceRef of another item in this batch. Resolved to an ID after Pass 1. Mutually exclusive with targetId and targetUrl.

targetUrl.description: Absolute URL the relationship points to. When set (or when 'type' is 'hyperlink'), a native Azure DevOps 'Hyperlink' relation is created instead of a work-item-to-work-item link. Mutually exclusive with targetId and targetRef.
